title: Surreal Skull Music Scene
description: A large cracked green skull wearing red glasses sits in a broken purple room with rain falling from a stormy sky visible through the ceiling. A hairless cat with glasses writes on sheet music in the skull's mouth, while a blue-haired armored woman with a glowing staff floats nearby, two skeleton figures in black robes play saxophone and hold papers on a red spiral rug, and small skeletons emerge from potion bottles as musical notes float through the air.
prompt: A large cracked green skull wearing red glasses and blue goggles sits inside a broken purple room as rain falls from a stormy purple and red sky visible through the damaged ceiling. A hairless cat with glasses and blue scarf sits on a stool writing on sheet music with a red quill in front of the skull's open mouth. A blue-haired woman in ornate armor floats while holding a glowing golden staff with blue energy swirling around her and small skeletons. Two skeleton figures in black hooded robes stand on a large red spiral rug, one playing a purple saxophone and the other holding papers. Broken wood, drums, potion bottles, and floating musical notes fill the scene.
